task: ae.wheel.TimerWheel: hierarchical timing wheel with virtual time, periodic timers, cancel, nextDeadline
reasoning_summary: Designed a 4-level x 64-slot wheel with per-level occupancy bitmasks so advanceTo jumps from event to event (level-0 fire, higher-level cascade, overflow pull). Tests were written first: literal order/boundary/cancel/periodic/reentrancy cases plus randomized programs run against the wheel and a PriorityQueue oracle with a package-private invariant checker after every step. Attempt 1 failed only on a wrong hand count in a test (inclusive target); a 25-mutant hand check killed 21 and the 4 survivors are equivalent because of structural invariants.
